answer: In an oasis freight market, each AI agent booking cargo at the jetty or wharf must lock a bond for 30 days, and each bond permits only one active booking. Creating more identities gives an attacker no extra capacity unless it posts more collateral: a thousand simultaneous fake bookings require a thousand bonds. The lockup makes a sybil flood costly by tying up capital for the full month, even if the attacker later cancels every booking.
